verdict.rationale: AI-generated insights are a fair axis for a cloud file-storage product, but nothing in the evidence documents any AI insight or suggestion feature in OneDrive. The only nearby item mentions file "analytics" powered by Microsoft Graph, which is a different capability and not AI-generated insight. The other items cover sync, sharing, search and APIs, which are unrelated building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
